content.title: Implement: independent git branch worktree support
content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/independent-git-spec.md

Read the spec AND the review comments on issues mpcwd1suxc and mpcwd7ued6 before starting. The reviews contain critical feedback about feasibility, edge cases, and test impact.

Implement:
1. New module src/worktree.ts — git worktree operations (detectInitScenario, initFreshWorktree, initJoinWorktree, isWorktreeInitialized, pushWorktree, pullWorktree)
2. New CLI commands: src/cli/push.ts and src/cli/pull.ts
3. Modified src/cli/init.ts — enhanced to call worktree setup before tracker.init(), then auto-commit initial files
4. Modified src/runner.ts — register push and pull commands
5. Modified src/errors.ts — add new error codes (NOT_A_GIT_REPO, MIGRATION_REQUIRED, INVALID_STATE, PUSH_FAILED, PULL_FAILED)
6. Tests for worktree module and new CLI commands

content.content:
Key architecture decisions from CTO:

1. **Git plumbing for Scenario A** — use hash-object/mktree/commit-tree to create the orphan branch WITHOUT modifying the working tree. Never checkout the orphan branch. This avoids corrupting the user's working tree state.

2. **execFileSync over execSync** — use array-based argument passing (child_process.execFileSync('git', [...args])) to avoid shell injection. Never interpolate user input into command strings.

3. **No Tracker changes** — the existing file-io layer reads/writes .agentrack/ files identically whether it's a worktree or plain directory. Only the init/push/pull commands need new git logic.

4. **Existing init.ts flow** — the current init command finds/walks-to .agentrack/ and calls tracker.init(). The enhanced version adds worktree setup BEFORE tracker.init(), then auto-commits the initial data. The tracker.init() call itself is unchanged.

5. **Branch name _agentrack is hardcoded** — not configurable. Same for remote name 'origin'.

6. **Test strategy** — worktree tests will need real git operations. Use temporary git repos (git init) in test setup/teardown. Cannot mock git effectively for this feature.

7. **Synchronous git calls** — match the codebase pattern (sync file-io). Use execFileSync, not spawn/async.

content.content: Done. Implemented independent git branch worktree support for agentrack. Files created: src/core/worktree.ts (git worktree operations), src/cli/commands/push.ts (agt push handler), src/cli/commands/pull.ts (agt pull handler). Files modified: src/core/errors.ts (5 new error codes 13-17), src/cli/commands/init.ts (worktree-aware with fallback to classic init when not in git repo), src/cli/runner.ts (registered push/pull commands), src/types/api.ts (WorktreeInitResult, WorktreeSyncResult, WorktreePullResult types), src/types/index.ts and src/index.ts (barrel exports). Key decisions: backward compatible (classic init in non-git repos), orphan branch via git plumbing commands, synchronous execFileSync with stdio pipe to prevent stderr leaking, race condition fallback from fresh to join, gitignore appended but not staged/committed. Quality: typecheck clean, lint clean, 573 tests pass 0 fail.
